counting_note: R3-001..R3-008 are the remediation items under review. R4-001..R4-004 are new/residual defects found in this round. F1-F10 and R2-001..R2-010 are regression-checked. FIXED is limited to the stated subparts and never implies live acceptance.

r3_findings.title: Private event boundary added, but Store.save() and artifact() still re-anchor arbitrary task state and reset the 10+10 budget
r3_findings.observed: Standalone Store.event() now verifies the anchor in a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and rejects tampered state; artifact() entry, recordIntent/recordAck/recordTerminal and init are also fail-closed. However Store.save() verifies the OLD persisted row and then unconditionally writes the caller-supplied task object. A caller can pass a task with aRound=10/bRound=9 changed to 0/0; save() writes it and the trusted append makes verify() accept the new chain head. The 10+10 budget is reset. artifact() verifies before the file write/fsync and starts its transaction afterwards; a concurrent tamper during the write window is re-anchored by the same trusted append.
r3_findings.residual: The private #trustedEventWrite flag protects event() but not the state mutation boundary. Any in-process caller with Store access (or a future Controller bug) can reset budget/status/history/frozen/taskSpec. The artifact fsync window is a narrower concurrency variant.
r3_findings.minimal_fix: Make save() validate immutable/monotonic fields before UPDATE (frozen.digest unchanged, baseSha unchanged, aRound/bRound non-decreasing, currentSha only advancing through validated transitions), or make the mutation API accept a transition function rather than an arbitrary object. For artifact(), begin the transaction before verify and keep it open through file write, or re-verify the state hash inside the transaction before the trusted append.

r3_findings.title: Frozen/TASK_SPEC integrity rejects the old-digest case, but a recomputed digest/sha and incomplete pairs still pass
r3_findings.observed: authorizeRecovery now calls assertFrozenIntegrity and compliance before writing an artifact. Tampering frozen content while keeping the old digest is rejected; tampering TASK_SPEC while keeping the old sha is rejected; over-budget, modified policy, unresolved dispatch, non-BLOCKED and wrong basis are rejected. However save() can change frozen content AND recompute frozen.digest, or change taskSpec AND recompute taskSpecSha; assertFrozenIntegrity then passes and authorizeRecovery accepts the forged basis. assertFrozenIntegrity skips the TASK_SPEC check when only one of taskSpec/taskSpecSha is present; both incomplete variants were accepted (PLANNER / PREPARE).
r3_findings.residual: The check is self-consistency, not authenticity. The unkeyed local hash chain cannot resist a caller that recomputes the digest; the remaining gap is the public save() transition boundary and the incomplete-pair condition.
r3_findings.minimal_fix: Require both taskSpec and taskSpecSha to be present or both absent; reject a lone value. Validate frozen/taskSpec immutability in save(). Document that external anchoring is still required against a privileged re-hasher.

r3_findings.title: run() preserves NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, inflight, reason and receipt, and does not redispatch
r3_findings.observed: run() verifies the ledger first and throws 'task state NEEDS_RECONCILIATION: reconcile before dispatch' if status is NEEDS_RECONCILIATION or inflight is set, before any live preflight. With P1_LIVE_ALLOWED unset, stage/status/pendingHuman/inflight and the event count are unchanged. A failed preflight only seals BLOCKED when status is READY and no inflight exists. A real reviewer pair one-success/one-failure and an execute failure after intent both leave NEEDS_RECONCILIATION and do not redispatch. The prior-round defect-reproduction probe now fails as expected because the old overwrite no longer occurs.
r3_findings.residual: There is still no automated reconcile command; a NEEDS_RECONCILIATION task requires external/manual reconciliation. This is fail-closed but operationally incomplete.

r3_findings.title: Windows taskkill uses childEnv
r3_findings.observed: spawn('taskkill',...{env:childEnv()}) is present; childEnv excludes a synthetic sentinel; a real child process cannot see it; the timeout kill path still terminates a long child.

r3_findings.title: Remote Popen execute worker uses child_env
r3_findings.observed: Popen passes env=child_env(cfg). A real submit/execute/harness run with a synthetic gateway sentinel produced SENTINEL=ABSENT in the harness stdout log; the mocked Popen kwargs also omit the sentinel and include PATH.

r3_findings.title: CLI usage renders a real newline between recover commands
r3_findings.observed: node src/cli.mjs help contains 'EXACT_COMMIT\n  recover --id' as a real newline and not the literal backslash-n.

r3_findings.title: APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS severity is consistent; LOW/MEDIUM comments do not bypass P0 quorum or unresolved findings
r3_findings.observed: Local and remote parsers keep APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS for LOW/MEDIUM/INFO/ADVISORY findings and downgrade HIGH/unclassified to FAIL; PASS with any finding is rejected. SshP0Adapter accepts signed APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS with LOW/MEDIUM, rejects HIGH and PASS+LOW. P0 passed remains false when any seat has an unresolved finding; one LOW-comment seat + one PASS does not pass; LOW + FAIL is a dispute; a single seat and duplicate physical IDs cannot form quorum.

r3_findings.title: Terminal indented/pretty/fenced JSON is accepted; multiple verdict objects can let a terminal PASS override an earlier FAIL
r3_findings.observed: Indented bare JSON, pretty JSON, CRLF and a single terminal fenced block are accepted; trailing prose, truncated JSON and non-terminal fences are rejected; nested/example objects do not override a real failing envelope; the last standalone object is authoritative. An earlier example fence followed by a terminal verdict fence is rejected as a whole (conservative fail-closed, not a PASS bypass). A report containing a real standalone FAIL object followed by a standalone PASS object is parsed as PASS (terminal-object-wins); an inline example is rejected.
r3_findings.residual: R4-005 HIGH: two standalone verdict objects are accepted and the last one wins; a terminal PASS can override an earlier FAIL. R4-004 LOW: multi-fence example+terminal verdict rejected conservatively.
r3_findings.minimal_fix: Reject reports with more than one line-start object carrying verdict, or require the terminal object to be the only verdict object; then keep the single-terminal-fence rule or iterate fences from the end.

residual_findings.title: Store.save() accepts an arbitrary task object and re-anchors aRound/bRound/status/stage/history/frozen/taskSpec
residual_findings.repro: Init a BLOCKED task with aRound=10,bRound=9; t=store.get(id); t.aRound=0;t.bRound=0; store.save(t,'BUDGET_RESET'); store.verify(id) passes; get(id) shows 0/0. Tamper status/stage/history likewise. Change frozen.intent and recompute frozen.digest, save, then authorizeRecovery(expectedBasis=frozen.digest) succeeds. Change taskSpec and recompute taskSpecSha, save, then authorizeRecovery(expectedBasis=taskSpecSha) succeeds.
residual_findings.impact: The 10+10 budget can be reset through a public Store write path; the ledger is re-anchored and verify() accepts it. This defeats the R3-001 invariant and undermines R3-002.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Add immutable/monotonic validation in save() before UPDATE (frozen.digest, baseSha, taskSpecSha, aRound/bRound non-decreasing, currentSha validated transition) or make save() accept a transition function. Add regression tests that a tampered task object is rejected.

residual_findings.title: assertFrozenIntegrity is self-consistency only; forged matching digest/sha and incomplete TASK_SPEC pairs pass recovery
residual_findings.repro: Change frozen content and recompute frozen.digest via save(); authorizeRecovery with the new digest moves to PLANNER. Change taskSpec and recompute taskSpecSha via save(); authorizeRecovery moves to A_WORKER. Set taskSpec but taskSpecSha=null (or vice versa), save(); authorizeRecovery accepts and moves to PLANNER/PREPARE.
residual_findings.impact: A forged frozen config/TASK_SPEC can be accepted as the recovery basis if the caller can recompute the unkeyed digest; incomplete TASK_SPEC pairs are not rejected.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Require both taskSpec and taskSpecSha to be present or both absent. Add immutable-field checks in save(). Document that the unkeyed ledger requires an external anchor against a privileged re-hasher.

residual_findings.title: artifact() verifies before the file write/transaction; a concurrent tamper during fsync is re-anchored by the trusted append
residual_findings.repro: Patch fs.writeFileSync to change aRound/bRound to 0/0 during the artifact file write; store.artifact(id,'concurrent-probe.json',...) then appends the trusted ARTIFACT_REGISTERED event; verify() passes and get(id) shows 0/0.
residual_findings.impact: A concurrent writer can reset the budget or alter state during the artifact write window; the trusted append re-anchors it. This is a narrower but real variant of R4-001.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Begin the transaction before verify and keep it open through the file write, or capture the expected state hash before the file write and assert it inside the transaction before #appendVerifiedMutation.

residual_findings.title: A multi-fence report (example fence + terminal verdict fence) is rejected as a whole
residual_findings.repro: Report contains an example ```json PASS block followed by a terminal ```json FAIL block. parseAgentOutput throws 'missing strict final JSON envelope' instead of taking the terminal FAIL block.
residual_findings.impact: Conservative fail-closed; no PASS bypass. Requires manual reconciliation for a legitimate multi-fence output.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Iterate fenced blocks from the end and use the last complete block, or document the single-terminal-fence contract.

residual_findings.title: Two standalone verdict objects are accepted; a terminal PASS can override an earlier FAIL
residual_findings.repro:
parseAgentOutput('## report
'+JSON.stringify({verdict:'FAIL',summary:'real failure',findings:['BLOCKER: x']})+'
'+JSON.stringify({verdict:'PASS',summary:'example after verdict',findings:[]})) returns PASS ('example after verdict'). An inline 'Example: {...}' form is rejected.
residual_findings.impact: A reviewer/agent report containing a real FAIL and a terminal PASS object is parsed as PASS, so a review FAIL can be lost without manual reconciliation. This is a parser trust bypass, not a test result.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Reject reports that contain more than one line-start object with a verdict, or require the terminal object to be the only verdict object. Add a regression test for FAIL followed by PASS.

residual_findings.title: Invisible Unicode prefixes beyond the blacklist are accepted as path components
residual_findings.repro: Create a file named U+00AD.env, U+034F.env, U+180E.env, U+3164.env or U+2800.env and call commitWorktree; each is accepted. U+200B.env is rejected.
residual_findings.impact: These names are not exact .env aliases on NTFS, but the invisible prefix makes them visually resemble .env and defeats the stated ambiguous-path/Unicode-format rejection intent. Defense-in-depth gap.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Reject all Unicode Cf/Cc and leading/trailing whitespace in every path component (e.g. /[\p{Cf}\p{Cc}]/u) or use a positive allowlist; add tests for the listed code points.

residual_findings.title: validateStaged revalidates only symlink/gitlink entries present in diff --cached, not pre-existing index entries
residual_findings.observed: Static: validateStaged asserts mode 120000/160000 only when the path is in diff --cached. A symlink/gitlink already tracked in the base ref and unchanged is not revalidated.
residual_findings.impact: A base repository that already contains a sensitive symlink/gitlink remains in the commit tree; the Controller does not audit the base. This is not a confirmed new-path bypass and no such base was exercised.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Optionally scan the full index for sensitive symlink/gitlink targets at prepare time, or document that the approved base ref is out of scope.
